^the almighty elder^\255\003^the grand poobah, Purple Tentacle,
column2: ^全能的長老^\255\003^至高無上的大人物，紫色觸手，

column1: not to let ANYONE near this clock.
column2: 不准讓任何人靠近這座鐘。

column1: But I have rights!  I'm a tentacle!
column2: 可是我有權利！我是觸手耶！

column1: And a darned attractive one, I might add.
column2: 而且還是隻該死地迷人的觸手，容我補充。

column1: I'm sorry^
column2: 我很抱歉^

column1: But no one gets to this clock while I'm here^
column2: 但只要我在這裡，誰也碰不到這座鐘^

column1: ^and unless I have to go chase down some escaped humans, I'm glued to this spot!
column2: ^除非我得去追逃跑的人類，否則我就黏在這個位置上！

column1: Rats!
column2: 可惡！

column1: You heard the man!\255\003Escape!
column2: 你聽到他說的了！\255\003快逃！

column1: I doubt if I could budge it.
column2: 我看我推不動它。

column1: This is an antique.
column2: 這是古董。

column1: It certainly is!
column2: 那還用說！

column1: It leads to Dr. Fred's old lab.
column2: 它通往佛瑞德博士的舊實驗室。

column1: I wonder if that still leads down to Doctor Fred's old lab.
column2: 不知道那裡是不是還通往佛瑞德博士的舊實驗室。

column1: Tentacles only upstairs.\255\003Behave or I'll take you to the kennel.
column2: 樓上只准觸手上去。\255\003給我規矩點，不然我就把你送去狗籠。

column1: If I only had a tentacle costume^
column2: 要是我有件觸手裝就好了^

column1: `This four-hundred-year-old clock is an amusing example of primitive human timekeeping.`
column2: `這座四百年歷史的鐘，是原始人類計時方式的有趣範例。`

column1: It looks pretty well stuck there.
column2: 它卡在那裡卡得很牢。

column1: Harold
column2: 哈洛

column1: Oh, my!\255\003A novelty vanishing fluid!\255\003How^ witty!
What ever will you clever tentacles think up next?
column2: 你們這些聰明的觸手接下來還想得出什麼？

column1: I don't know!
column2: 我不知道！

column1: Of course you don't.
column2: 你當然不知道。

column1: Get away from me, you mangy mutt!
column2: 離我遠一點，你這隻爛毛雜種狗！

column1: If you're going to try to sabotage my chances of winning the show^\255\003^you'll have to be MUCH more clever than that!
column2: 如果你想破壞我贏得比賽的機會^\255\003^你得再高明得多才行！

column1: I think he's spoken for.
column2: 我看他名花有主了。

column1: You better believe it.
column2: 那還用說。

column1: You're talking to the wrong people.\255\003We like it here.\255\003We're celebrities.
column2: 你找錯人了。\255\003我們喜歡這裡。\255\003我們是名人。

column1: Hi.  My name's Laverne.\255\003I'm a sophomore.
column2: 嗨。我叫拉玟。\255\003我大二。

column1: My name's Harold.\255\003I'm a thoroughbred.
column2: 我叫哈洛。\255\003我是純種的。

column1: How's it hangin', Harold?
column2: 最近怎樣啊，哈洛？

column1: I'm sure I don't know.
column2: 我實在不知道。

column1: That's quite a tutu you've got there.
column2: 你那件芭蕾舞裙真不賴。

column1: Where is your owner?
column2: 你的主人呢？

column1: Is your hair naturally blue?
column2: 你的毛天生就是藍的嗎？

column1: What are you^ uh^ guys waiting for?
column2: 你們^呃^在等什麼？

column1: Hey, hold that thought.  I gotta boogie.
column2: 欸，這話先擱著。我得閃了。

column1: Well, then, good luck.
column2: 那麼，祝你好運。

column1: Who needs luck when you've got beauty?
column2: 有美貌誰還需要運氣？

column1: Thank you.\255\003My owner paid quite a lot of money for it.\255\003My owner buys me anything I want.
column2: 謝謝。\255\003我主人花了不少錢買的。\255\003我要什麼主人就買什麼。

column1: He's not here right now^
column2: 他現在不在^

column1: ^but he would be, if he in any way possibly could.
column2: ^但只要有任何可能，他一定會在場。

column1: His bus broke down in Pittsburgh, so he's stuck there with the other owners.
column2: 他的巴士在匹茲堡拋錨了，所以他跟其他主人一起卡在那裡。

column1: This is the first show I've ever done^
column2: 這是我第一次參加比賽^

column1: ^alone.
column2: ^自己一個人。

column1: Natural?  How gauche!\255\003This took several very expensive sessions at a posh grooming salon!\255\003I've got the hair competition in the bag!
column2: 天生的？真俗氣！\255\003這可是在高級美容沙龍做了好幾次昂貴療程的成果！\255\003毛髮組冠軍我拿定了！

column1: We're all waiting for the human show to begin, of course.
column2: 我們當然都在等人類展開始。

column1: If you have a human you want to enter, you'd better get it down here.
column2: 如果你有人類要報名，最好快把牠帶下來。

column1: If your owner's going to enter you, they'd better get you some name tags, quick.
column2: 如果你主人要幫你報名，他們最好快點幫你弄名牌。

column1: But then again, why bother?\255\003My owner says I'M going to win.\255\003I'm the most beautiful human there is.
column2: 不過話說回來，何必呢？\255\003我主人說贏的會是我。\255\003我是世上最美的人類。

column1: Keep in touch.
column2: 保持聯絡。

column1: Remember me?  I'm Laverne.
column2: 記得我嗎？我是拉玟。

column1: Hi, I'm Laverne.
column2: 嗨，我是拉玟。

column1: What did you say was upstairs?
column2: 你剛說樓上有什麼來著？

column1: What's upstairs?
column2: 樓上有什麼？

column1: Nice clock.
column2: 鐘不錯。

column1: Is that a real moustache?
column2: 那鬍子是真的嗎？

column1: You look sort of dopey standing there with a net.
column2: 你拿著網子站在那裡看起來有點呆。

column1: Did you get a free sandwich with that hat?
column2: 那頂帽子有附贈三明治嗎？

column1: Nothing that you need to worry about.\255\003An old time capsule and some worthless human relics.
column2: 沒什麼需要你操心的。\255\003一個舊時光膠囊和一些不值錢的人類遺物。

column1: And, of course, the showroom.
column2: 當然，還有展示廳。

column1: Off limits to humans, naturally, except for the showroom.
column2: 人類自然是禁止進入，展示廳除外。

column1: Rather.\255\003No one is to touch it, especially humans.
column2: 那還用說。\255\003誰也不准碰它，尤其是人類。

column1: That's regrettable.\255\003Perhaps you should see the doctor.
column2: 那真遺憾。\255\003也許你該去看醫生。

column1: Hrmf.
column2: 哼。

column1: I'm very sorry, but there's nothing I can do about that.
column2: 我很抱歉，但這我無能為力。

column1: Now, be off with you.
column2: 好了，走開吧。

column1: Ah, hello.
column2: 啊，你好。

column1: I say, have I told you about the time I tracked an escaped human to Madagascar?\255\003He had stowed away aboard a tuna boat you see, and I narrowly missed stopping it leaving port.\255\003Unfortunately, the only other available transport was a rowboat, so I--
column2: 我說啊，我跟你講過我一路追捕逃亡人類到馬達加斯加那次嗎？\255\003他偷渡上了一艘鮪魚船，你想想，我就差那麼一點沒攔下它出港。\255\003不巧的是，當時唯一還能用的交通工具是一艘划艇，所以我——

column1: I say, have I told you about the time I was nearly caught in a wheat thresher?\255\003I had tracked a renegade human to a farm in Iowa.\255\003There was a dummy in the field which was presumably meant to scare away crows or thieves.\255\003Anyway, the amusing bit is that--
column2: 我說啊，我跟你講過我差點被脫穀機捲進去那次嗎？\255\003我追一個叛逃的人類到愛荷華的一座農場。\255\003田裡立著一個假人，大概是用來嚇烏鴉或小偷的。\255\003總之，好笑的地方在於——

column1: Have I told you about the time I tracked a human all the way to the North Pole?\255\003He was a short one, I remember, with curiously pointed ears.\255\003I had to eat my sled dogs by the time I caught up with him.\255\003He had holed up in a workshop there, and there was a fat human in a rather garish red suit who--
column2: 我跟你講過我一路把人類追到北極那次嗎？\255\003我記得他個子矮矮的，耳朵尖得很奇怪。\255\003追上他的時候，我已經把雪橇犬都吃光了。\255\003他躲進那裡的一間工坊，還有個穿著俗豔紅衣的胖人類——

column1: I say, have I told you about the time I--
column2: 我說啊，我跟你講過我那次——

column1: Yes, you've told me that one.
column2: 是啊，那個你講過了。

column1: ^umm^
Never mind, I forgot what I was going to say.
column2: 算了，我忘記要說什麼了。

column1: Well, be seeing you.
column2: 那麼，回頭見。

column1: Aren't you curious about what's inside the clock?
column2: 你不好奇鐘裡面有什麼嗎？

column1: Couldn't I please touch the clock?
column2: 拜託讓我摸一下鐘好不好？

column1: You're quite a tracker, aren't you?
column2: 你追蹤本領挺高的嘛？

column1: Has anybody ever escaped from this place?
column2: 有人從這裡逃出去過嗎？

column1: Be seeing you.
column2: 回頭見。

column1: `Laverne`, eh?\255\003Curious name for a tentacle, I must say.\255\003Are you here for the show?
column2: `拉玟`，是吧？\255\003我得說，對觸手來說這名字真怪。\255\003你是來參加比賽的嗎？

column1: Yes, it's a valuable antique.\255\003I'd like to show it to you, but I'm presently charged with the task of guarding it.\255\003No one will get near it while I'm here!
column2: 是的，這是貴重的古董。\255\003我很樂意讓你看，但我目前奉命看守它。\255\003只要我在這裡，誰也別想靠近！

column1: Some try once in a while, but I always fetch them back.\255\003That's my primary duty here, and I take it very seriously.\255\003I always get my man, no matter how long it takes.
column2: 偶爾有人會試，但我每次都把他們叼回來。\255\003那是我在這裡的首要職責，我非常認真看待。\255\003不管花多久，我一定逮到人。

column1: Why, I once trailed a renegade human for six days.\255\003He led me clear through the hills and up to the top of those mountains to the west.\255\003You couldn't possibly imagine the horrible things I had to eat to survive!
column2: 想當年，我曾經追一個叛逃的人類追了六天。\255\003他帶著我一路穿過丘陵，直上西邊那些山頭。\255\003你絕對想像不到我為了活命吃過什麼可怕的東西！

column1: Grub and maggot salad?
column2: 蠐螬蛆蟲沙拉？

column1: Putrefied squirrel intestines?
column2: 腐爛的松鼠腸子？

column1: Pieces of your own body?
column2: 你自己身上的肉？

column1: Cole slaw?
column2: 涼拌高麗菜絲？

column1: Good heavens!
column2: 我的老天！

column1: Yes, perhaps I can regale you with further tales of my tracking expertise.
column2: 是的，也許我可以再講幾則我追蹤本領的故事給你聽。

column1: Yes, perhaps I can regale you with tales of my adventures.
column2: 是的，也許我可以講幾則我的冒險故事給你聽。

column1: Sorry, no.\255\003No one touches the clock while I'M on duty.
column2: 抱歉，不行。\255\003我當班的時候誰也不准碰那座鐘。

column1: Not really.\255\003Guarding it is more or less the same no matter what's inside.
column2: 不太好奇。\255\003不管裡面裝什麼，看守起來都差不多。

column1: Rather.\255\003I always get my man, no matter how long it takes.
column2: 那還用說。\255\003不管花多久，我一定逮到人。

column1: Show?  No, I'm not here for the show.
column2: 比賽？不，我不是來參加比賽的。

column1: What show?
column2: 什麼比賽？

column1: Well, good luck to you, then.
column2: 那麼，祝你好運了。

column1: No?\255\003Are you a human owner?\255\003If you are, perhaps you should consider entering.
column2: 不是嗎？\255\003你是人類的主人嗎？\255\003如果是，也許你該考慮報名。

column1: Why, the human show, of course.\255\003It's the big event of the day.\255\003If you own a human, you might want to consider entering.
column2: 當然是人類展啊。\255\003那是今天的大事。\255\003如果你養了人類，也許可以考慮報名。

column1: There are some jolly good prizes to be won.\255\003Why, the grand prize is a dinner for two at Club Tentacle!
column2: 獎品可是相當豐厚。\255\003首獎是觸手俱樂部的雙人晚餐呢！

column1: Humans aren't allowed to roam free here.
column2: 人類不准在這裡自由走動。

column1: I'm taking you back to the kennel.
column2: 我要把你帶回狗籠。

column1: Boy, I wish I had a tentacle costume or something.\255\003But I can't even sew.
column2: 唉，真希望我有件觸手裝之類的。\255\003可是我連針線都不會。

column1: Hold it!
column2: 站住！

column1: I wish I had some sort of tentacle disguise.
column2: 真希望我有某種觸手偽裝。

column1: Well, that's the spirit!
column2: 這才對嘛！

column1: Everyone's raring to go!\255\003Let's get this show on the road!
column2: 大家都躍躍欲試！\255\003我們開始吧！

column1: Ah, here it comes^\255\003^my finest hour!
column2: 啊，來了^\255\003^我最光榮的時刻！

column1: It has three settings.
column2: 它有三段設定。

column1: `Cook,` `Jet Defrost,` and  `Mutilate Beyond Recognition.`
column2: `烹調`、`噴射解凍`、還有`絞爛到認不出來`。

column1: I've already thawed him out.
column2: 我已經把他解凍了。

column1: Besides, he won't let me insert the meat thermometer.
column2: 而且他不肯讓我插肉類溫度計。

column1: Nahhh^ too messy.
column2: 不要啦^太髒了。

column1: Maybe that isn't such a hot idea.
column2: 這主意好像沒那麼「熱門」。

column1: It's bad to put metal in a microwave.
column2: 微波爐裡不能放金屬。

column1: They may be oppressive and power-mad, but at least the tentacles recycle stuff.
column2: 觸手也許既高壓又權力薰心，但至少牠們有做資源回收。

column1: It has no door.
column2: 它沒有門。

column1: Sure, I guess I won't be needing it.
column2: 好啊，反正我大概用不到了。

column1: I can't do that.
column2: 我做不到。
